mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS declines over three months.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) both decline over three months, it signals a broad-based demand weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline over 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, especially during a recessionary regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS is below 1% during a recession.
